meta.title: Holiday Villa Thassos — Kinira, Thassos
meta.description: Apartments and studios less than 150 meters from the sea in Koinira, Thassos. Olive garden, BBQ, free parking, and Paradise Beach nearby.

common.perNightNote: Prices are per room (studio or apartment) per night.

home.headline: Olive trees, sand and sea
home.support: Your heaven on the eastern coast of Thassos — less than 150 meters from the shore in picturesque Koinira.
home.welcomeBody: HOLIDAY VILLA THASSOS is located less than 150 meters from the seacoast in the picturesque area of Koinira. Our apartments and studios are the perfect choice for families and friends who wish to spend a relaxing and exciting holiday by the sea on the island of Thassos.
home.welcomeGarden: Our olive garden boasts two barbeque spots and a free private parking area. Are you looking for new experiences and thrills? Do you wish to embark on an adventure? Your holiday with us has it all covered.
home.adventureTitle: Are you looking for new experiences and thrills?
home.adventureSubtitle: Do you wish to embark on an adventure?
home.adventureBody: The beautiful sandy Paradise Beach is located two kilometers to the south. It is famous for its amazing sights, azure seas, fine sand and crystal clear waters. The nearby rocks are a tempting site for snorkeling enthusiasts. Not surprisingly Paradise Beach has been awarded with a Blue Flag.
home.adventureGolden: Also, six kilometers to the north you will find the popular Golden Beach. Cafes, taverns and shops are in close proximity. If you dream of spending your holiday at a beautiful location surrounded by olive trees, sand and sea, your heaven is here with us!
home.commodities: Our studios and apartments offer all necessary commodities for a pleasant stay.
home.tourTeaserBody: Explore our studios and apartments from anywhere before you book.
home.staysBody: Eight self-catering units for families and friends — garden terraces below, sea-view balconies above.

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.intro: Four sea-view apartments on the second floor and four garden-view studios on the ground and first floors — all with air conditioning, kitchenettes, bathrooms, balconies or terraces, satellite TV and free Wi‑Fi.
accommodation.studiosView: Olive garden view · Ground & first floor · Up to 4 guests
accommodation.studiosBody: Spacious living room with a fully equipped kitchenette, a separate bedroom with two single beds and a bunk bed, private bathroom, and a large terrace overlooking the olive garden.
accommodation.apartmentsView: Sea & Koinira island view · Second floor · Up to 4 guests
accommodation.apartmentsBody: Separate bedroom plus living room with kitchenette (cooking facilities, fridge, bunk bed), private bathroom, and a large balcony with Aegean views — ideal for two adults and two children.

services.title: Services
services.intro: Everything you need for a comfortable, self-catered stay by the sea.
services.cleaningBody: Cleaning, towels and linen every three days.
services.parkingBody: Secure parking on the property at no extra cost.
services.bbqBody: Two barbeque areas in the olive garden for evenings outdoors.
services.wifiBody: High-speed internet indoors and in the garden.
services.staffBody: Friendly hosts ready to help with tips and local advice.

villaPolicy.title: Villa Policy
villaPolicy.checkInBody: Check-in is between 14:00 and 23:00. Check-out is between 07:00 and 10:30.
villaPolicy.depositBody: A 30% deposit by bank transfer secures your booking. You will receive a voucher upon receipt of the deposit. The remaining 70% is paid on arrival in cash only.
villaPolicy.cancelBody: Cancellations 22 days or more before arrival: full deposit refund (minus bank fees). Cancellations less than 21 days before arrival or no-show: deposit forfeited. Early departure: pay 50% of remaining nights (Article 8 N1652/86 / GG 167 A).
villaPolicy.smokingBody: Smoking is not allowed inside the studios and apartments.

thassos.title: Thassos Island
thassos.intro: Thassos is the northernmost Greek island in the Aegean — green hills, sandy beaches and crystal water.
thassos.koiniraBody: Our villa sits in Koinira (Kinira), a quiet eastern-coast village surrounded by olive groves, close to Paradise Beach and within easy reach of Golden Beach, taverns and shops.
thassos.ferriesBody: Regular ferries connect Keramoti to Limenas and Kavala to Prinos. Fly into Kavala (KVA) or Thessaloniki (SKG) and continue by road and ferry.

location.title: How to find us
location.byCarBody: From Keramoti take the ferry to Limenas (Thassos town), then drive south-east along the coastal road toward Koinira. From Kavala you can also ferry to Prinos and continue by road.
location.byPlaneBody: Closest airport: Kavala (KVA). Alternative: Thessaloniki (SKG). Rent a car or arrange a transfer to the ferry ports.
